title: The Contact of Vienna Again
author: Hazel Voss
blurb: Rosalind Sandoval, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
